scope: Scoped rereview of CORE-01 through CORE-04 fixes in revision resolution and corresponding workflow tests. Not a full Task 3 completion or integration verdict.

original_findings.evidence: Source identity matching now runs before project-code fallback and includes the effective corrected code. test_reparse_preserves_project_correction_at_same_source verifies that automatic LAB_WBC -> human LAB_HGB -> parser LAB_HGB retains the human value with a conflict.

Inherited disagreement fields are unioned with revision_conflicts and revision_conflict is ORed with prior state. test_defer_keeps_value_source_across_two_reparses covers the previously failing multi-hop DEFER path.

Snapshots persist per-field observation/evidence/revision identity in value_sources. Status changes preserve it, and the resolver reconstructs original_observation_id/carried_source_evidence from the raw value source. Field corrections update only affected field sources.

Ordinary CORRECT no longer clears reparse conflicts. Explicit KEEP_REVISION or USE_AUTOMATIC actions require an existing conflict, clear it deliberately, and preserve undo snapshots. test_unrelated_edit_cannot_clear_reparse_value_conflict and test_explicit_reparse_resolution_is_reversible_and_preserves_sources cover these operations.
